query: Which regression/standardization approaches best adjust for changing denominators and evolving test mix over three years (offsets, standardization, stratified or case‑mix models)?

response.query: Which regression/standardization approaches best adjust for changing denominators and evolving test mix over three years (offsets, standardization, stratified or case‑mix models)?
response.answer: For evolving test mix and changing denominators, stratified or case-mix models are best. These approaches adjust for variations in patient characteristics and test distributions over time.
